items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: This has never been clear to me. We did one of the weeks with the band. The second week was with a quintet with me, Miles, John Lewis, Al McKibbon, and Max. That’s the history of the band working to my memory, but my memory has some stops and goes in it.

I’m going to [unintelligible] your memory in a minute but I don’t want to get ahead of us, I want to talk a little bit more about that. Do you remember much about playing at the Royal Roost? They’ve released the Boris Rose air checks.
